title: Teacher Assignment and Reporting App (2017)
subtitle: JQuery, Bootstrap, Ajax, PHP, JSON, AWS (CloudFront, EC2, Ubuntu, SimpleDB)
text: After analyzing the competition's trends, I reconstructed the teacher dashboard application to modernize its interface and user experience for today's market.

featured.description: Designed and currently developing a teacher friendly dashboard used to assess students, create assignments as well as view reports with the districts, schools and parents.
